run_libsize_check: run libsize.py on a .so file to display its current file size
run_libsize_compare: run libsize.py to compare a .so file size against a previously saved baseline
run_libsize_baseline: run libsize.py to create a new baseline size file for future comparison
run_libsize_change: run libsize.py to report the byte and percentage change of a .so file size
run_libsize_validate: run libsize.py to validate that a .so file exists before measuring its size
